guard: unsupported native lifecycle operations refuse before inspect/adopt, and executeNativeLifecycle is the public registry entry
why: Capability refusal must happen before inspect or prepare.
At least one cell drives executeNativeLifecycle with a real registry provider and nothing injected.
Recorded receipts must match prepared resourceKey/bindingId/operationId before persist.
openView and preflight return typed provider results; discover authorizes each observation.

mutations.name: skip capability require before mutating dispatch
mutations.replace: dispatched = ((connection[request.operation] ?? (async () => { throw new Error("missing"); })) as typeof dispatched);
mutations.expectRed: unsupported adopt is refused before inspect
mutations.cell: unsupported adopt is refused before inspect

mutations.name: allow observed-mode mutation
mutations.find:
if (MUTATING.has(request.operation) && connection.capabilities.mode === "observed")
    return { state: "unsupported", operation: request.operation };
mutations.expectRed: observed-mode adopt is refused before inspect
mutations.cell: observed-mode adopt is refused before inspect

mutations.name: return recorded native receipt without persisting it
mutations.replace: const durable = { state: stored.state, record: stored } as Awaited<ReturnType<typeof queryOperation>>;
mutations.expectRed: adopt native-effect receipt is durable in the trusted store
mutations.cell: adopt native-effect receipt is durable in the trusted store

mutations.name: skip prepared receipt identity check
mutations.find:
if (!samePreparedIdentity(prepared.record, native.operation))
      return persistIndeterminate(kv, prepared.record, "provider recorded receipt does not match prepared resourceKey/bindingId/operationId");

mutations.name: discard NativeLifecycleView
mutations.find:
const view = await (method as NonNullable<NativeLifecycleConnection["openView"]>)(resourceKey, request.signal);
    return { state: "view", view };
mutations.expectRed: openView returns the NativeLifecycleView through the public entry
mutations.cell: openView returns the NativeLifecycleView through the public entry

mutations.name: hardcode preflight inspect and drop result
mutations.replace:
await (method as NonNullable<NativeLifecycleConnection["preflight"]>)("inspect", resourceKey, request.signal);
    return { state: "absent" };
mutations.expectRed: preflight uses targetOperation and preserves the typed refusal
mutations.cell: preflight uses targetOperation and preserves the typed refusal

mutations.name: return every discover observation
mutations.expectRed: discover dropped observations outside the grant selector
mutations.cell: discover dropped observations outside the grant selector

mutations.name: leave adopt binding at adopt-prepared
mutations.expectRed: adopt wrote a managed sessionbinding row
mutations.cell: adopt wrote a managed sessionbinding row

mutations.name: skip expectedBindingRevision CAS
mutations.find:
if (existing !== undefined && existing.revision !== request.expectedBindingRevision)
    throw new EpEnvelopeError("conflict", `native lifecycle ${request.operation} expected binding revision ${request.expectedBindingRevision} but store is at ${existing.revision}`);
mutations.expectRed: stale expectedBindingRevision is refused as conflict
mutations.cell: stale expectedBindingRevision is refused as conflict

mutations.name: always dispatch adopt
mutations.find:
const mutate = method as NonNullable<NativeLifecycleConnection["adopt" | "release" | "transfer" | "recover"]>;
    native = await mutate(nextBinding, prepared.record, request.signal);
mutations.expectRed: transfer dispatches the transfer method through the public entry
mutations.cell: transfer dispatches the transfer method through the public entry

mutations.name: persist terminal-success without native-effect proof
mutations.find:
if (native.operation.state === "terminal-success" && native.operation.proofOrigin?.proves !== "native-effect")
      return persistIndeterminate(kv, prepared.record, "provider returned terminal-success without native-effect proof");

mutations.name: treat cooperative-retirement as sufficient without preserved lifetime
mutations.find:
if ((durable.proofOrigin?.proves as string | undefined) !== "cooperative-retirement") return false;
  return nativeLifetimePreserved(durable.result);
mutations.replace:
if ((durable.proofOrigin?.proves as string | undefined) !== "cooperative-retirement") return false;
  return true;
mutations.expectRed: cooperative-retirement without nativeLifetimePreserved cannot advance to released
mutations.cell: cooperative-retirement without nativeLifetimePreserved cannot advance to released
